post.description:
Promote a model version to active in the durable PostgreSQL/Supabase registry.

Validates promotion gates automatically:
1. Minimum test accuracy gate (min_test_acc, default 0.85)
2. Minimum macro-F1 score gate (min_macro_f1, default 0.80)
3. Minimum per-class recall gate (min_class_recall, default 0.70)

schema.title: Response Promote Model Api V1 Admin Models Promote Post

post.description: Roll back active model to target version in durable database registry.

Translate the recommendation and expert guidance for a prediction on-demand.

- If requested in English, returns the canonical English recommendation.
- If already translated and cached in prediction.result["translations"][lang_code], returns from cache (0 ms).
- Otherwise, translates using IndicTrans2 on Colab/GPU server, caches in the database, and returns.

Request to add or update an email address for an authenticated user (e.g. phone signed-in user).
Sends a verification link to the target email address.

Validate that the requested mobile phone number is valid and not already
registered to another account before sending an SMS verification OTP.
Verify the phone number and link it to the user's account, then sync with Supabase Auth.
Verify email address using a valid verification token from the email link.

Resend verification email link for unverified email or pending update.
Anti-enumeration protection: always returns success.

Sets the password for a phone-registered user logging in via email for the first time
after verifying their mobile OTP. Future logins will only require this password.

get.description:
Get a secure 15-minute authorized URL for prediction media (raw leaf, processed overlay, or audio).
Strict Access Control:
- Farmer owner: Allowed for own predictions.
- Reviewing expert: Allowed if prediction has pending/verified expert review.
- Admin: Allowed for all predictions.
- Others: 403 Forbidden.

Executes 3-stage free-tier storage hygiene:
1. Purges unreferenced raw/processed images older than 1 hour grace period.
2. Prunes cached TTS audio files older than 30 days.
3. Prunes processed heatmaps for unflagged historical scans older than 7 days (self-heals on demand).
